主要内容: Coty's stock lost 67% in 2018 due to a series of challenges, including difficulties in integrating its acquisition of Cover Girl and other brands from Procter & Gamble, as well as internal executive upheaval that disrupted potential turnaround efforts. The decline was gradual, with investors losing confidence in the company's ability to recover. The stock saw a brief rebound in February following strong second-quarter earnings, but this was short-lived. Further declines occurred in May, August, and November, driven by weak consumer performance, supply-chain disruptions, and a significant revenue drop in the first-quarter earnings report. The company also faced leadership changes, with CEO Camillo Pane stepping down and Pierre Laubies taking over. Despite these challenges, Coty's stock has since risen by 10% in 2019, supported by market recovery and new leadership appointments aimed at addressing the company's pain points. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Procter & Gamble (PG), e.l.f. Beauty (ELF).
